description: Image Description: The image depicts an empty public restroom with a somewhat dated appearance. On the left side, there are three white porcelain sinks mounted along the wall, each with a faucet and a small shelf beneath. Above the sinks, there are two large windows allowing natural light to enter the room. The walls are partially tiled with white tiles, giving a clean but older look.
